team.name: Dipu
team.quote: If it leaves the cart late, it doesn't leave at all.
team.why: He runs the grill with one rule — the same plate every single time, never rushed.
team.imageAlt: A cook at the grill behind the Munchivo cart

team.name: Shakil
team.quote: The menu is short on purpose. Everything on it is something I'd want.
team.why: She runs the counter, the day and the details — and remembers what you ordered last time.
team.imageAlt: A cart lead arranging a paper tray at the Munchivo counter

team.name: Tamim
team.quote: A good sip should match the mood.
team.why: From a hot masala tea to a thick shake, he makes sure the sip goes with the bite.
team.imageAlt: A tall creamy milkshake from the Munchivo drinks corner

reviews.heroText: Real things people said after a stop at the cart. Read a few — then scroll down and leave your own.
reviews.formText: Leave a quick review — how was the bite, the sip, the stop? Your words go straight onto the wall below.
reviews.reviewPlaceholder: How was it? Keep it honest.
reviews.successNote: Thank you — your review is on the wall.

list.name: Saidul Alam
list.text: Ei food cart er khabar khub i valo, price o onek kom. Ami ekhane abar ashbo.

list.name: Sadia K.
list.text: The MeatBox genuinely ruined other burgers for me. Crispy, saucy, huge — and it was ready in minutes.

list.name: Tanvir H.
list.text: Stopped for a masala tea on a whim and left with two Mini Burgers as well. That combo is dangerous.

list.name: Nusrat J.
list.text: Fresh, fast and full of flavor. The pasta was still steaming when I got back to the office.

list.name: Rafi A.
list.text: The piyaju tastes like the real Patenga thing. And the milkshake? Thickest I have had in the city.

about.text: Munchivo is run by three friends with a simple idea: good food belongs out there, and a short stop can be the best part of the day.
about.teamAside: Three friends, one cart, and a shared obsession with doing street food properly. This is the crew that keeps Munchivo moving.
about.whyText: Three of us, one cart, and the belief that the good stuff should come to you — no fuss, no long lines, no overthinking.

reasons.title: Cravings deserve a shortcut
reasons.text: Sometimes the best decision of the day is the one you make in ten seconds.

reasons.title: Street food feels like a moment
reasons.text: Not just a meal — a warm light, a good smell, and something worth stopping for.

reasons.title: A small cart can give a big smile
reasons.text: Six things, done properly, over and over. That is the whole job, and we love it.

about.lineupText: From savory bites to a warm or cold sip, the Munchivo menu keeps the choice simple.
